name: Sun Resort
description: A beach resort on a private island, with an overwater spa.
check_in_notes: Please show photo ID and the credit card used for booking at check-in. Let us know your arrival time in advance.
cancellation_prepayment: Cancellation and prepayment policies vary by rate — check the conditions of each option before booking.
child_policies: Children of all ages are welcome. Children 12 years and above are charged as adults.
cot_extra_bed_policies: Cots available on request (free). Extra beds on request charged per night and paid separately at the property. Subject to availability.
fine_print: Transfers run by shared speedboat and seaplane. Share flight details at least 7 days before arrival.
